Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Chrysanthemum [鞠華], flavor bitter, neutral. It mainly treats wind headache with dizziness, swelling and pain, eyes as if about to fall out, tearing, dead flesh of the skin, and aversion to wind and damp bi [濕痹]. Taken over a long time, it frees blood qi and lightens the body
